notes.title: Beads or Foam
notes.description: Two identical small red boxes hide beads and silent foam; the small plastic shell makes the beads rattle clearly. Shake one box to identify the rattler, then use the remaining lift and push probes to calibrate its flick: about 0.233 N·s sends its 0.124 kg mass roughly 0.60 m.
notes.prompt: two red boxes: one full of beads, one with silent foam, small budget
